name: MTC UK 2K Android TV
summary: MTC UK 2K Android TV ships with Google ads, ambient promos and junk apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This MediaTek-based set shares its firmware family with JVC UK sets. It ships with Google launcher ad and recommendation services, Google telemetry and ambient screensaver ads, and a layer of preloaded junk. The list also covers a calendar app and the voice assistant, which are off by choice.

The firmware limits what Android will report about the set, so checks rely on package lists and screenshots. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. The phone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi, and the TV asks you once to allow debugging.
keep: The Play Store and Google Play Services
Keyboards, TV inputs, the remote and Bluetooth pairing
notes: This firmware hides much of the set's status from Android, so a few checks work differently than on other TVs.
The list includes the Freeview Play app layer. Leave those lines on in the app if you watch Freeview Play.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my MTC UK 2K?
faq.a: Not with the default list, because the voice assistant is turned off by choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: Mostly. It turns off the Google launcher ad and recommendation services and the ambient ads.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
